faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.text: Quick answers to the questions we hear most.

items.question: How do we get started?
items.answer: Send us a message or give us a call. We schedule a free first call to understand your needs.

items.question: How much does a project cost?
items.answer: It depends on the scope. After the first call you get a fixed price in writing.

items.question: How long does it take?
items.answer: Small projects take a few weeks; larger ones are planned in clear phases.

items.question: Do you offer support after the project?
items.answer: Yes. Flexible support plans make sure you are never on your own.
